human.handoff.session-evaluation: Native Human Benefit Evidence builds and verifies a deterministic evaluation from exact session receipts.
human.handoff.explicit-judgment: The numeric signal remains NOT_RUN until a separate explicit claim-scoped judgment is entered.
human.handoff.local-source-declaration: A native digest-bound NAMED_LOCAL_STEWARD declaration binds protocol, sessions, evaluation, judgment, scope and judgeRef.
human.handoff.v2-bridge-compose: The additive handoff composes declaration, current closure and v2 bridge without selecting the judgment.

human.handoff.every-current-chain: The exact interactive selector resolves all four current routes through the v2 handoff.
human.handoff.candidate-ancestry: Two current routes retain exact CANDIDATE ancestry.
human.handoff.reuse-existing-ancestry: Two current routes retain exact REUSE_EXISTING ancestry without a fabricated candidate.

human.handoff.tty-only: The interactive handoff refuses piped or automated input before reading session evidence.
human.handoff.external-session-input: Session inputs inside the Workshop repository are refused.
human.handoff.no-write: The core performs no I/O and the interactive driver emits to stdout only.
human.handoff.no-auto-participation: No session starts and no judgment is created automatically.

human.handoff.declaration-not-authentica: The local declaration explicitly authenticates neither identity nor human presence and cannot represent a cohort.
human.handoff.synthetic-hold: Synthetic positive signals and fixture judgments remain SYNTHETIC_HOLD and map to UNKNOWN.
human.handoff.current-closure-bind: Closure covers cycle, protocol, evaluation, judgment, intervention link, comparison surfaces, baseline, exact capability surface and source declaration.

authority.human-steward.preserve: No participation request, verdict, install, permission, promotion, merge, CANON or Foundation authority.

growth.human-evidence.live: No person opted in; no LIVE session, judgment, admitted bridge package or grounded human outcome exists.
